text: Chronic medications at the top of the chart are what families can reorder in their portal.
Here's Maple's chart.
To add one, click Medication,
search the inventory,
and pick the item. Pick it from inventory, not free text, so the family can reorder it.
Catalog means it's linked.
Each one shows its refills. Items that need no prescription, like joint chews, show PRN.
Click them to open the refills window.
A doctor adds refills here.
Save refills.
Saved.
This one was typed as free text, so the family can't reorder it online.
Search the inventory,
and link it.
Now it's linked. The SOAP's chronic medications work the same way.
In her portal, Maria sees them, with refills left, and Reorder.
She reorders the flea and tick chewable.
Place order.
With refills on file, it goes straight to Fill, with the directions from the prescription.
The most common mistakes: typing a medication we sell as free text, and leaving no refills on a medication meant to continue.
Remember: pick chronic medications from inventory, and keep their refills current.
